headline: BOMB DEFUSE teaches its first vent
lede: The co-op defusal pair now coaches itself: on your run's first vent the plate names YOUR seat's job by key, the bar you must hold pulses until you actually hold it, and the gauge shouts TAP exactly when the needle is in the green. After your first SEALED the lesson packs up — veterans keep the clean plate. The whole lesson is pure view math: the bomb's determinism core never hears about it.

notes.text: ventCoach: one pure helper drives the whole lesson — role card during READ-STEP, amber ring on the unpinned bar, green TAP! on the zone — with hash-purity gates proving it cannot touch the sim, and net-twins proving both boxes teach the same thing.

The drive fixes a real crash: the online reseat's hud literal had silently dropped its spring state, so the guest page threw pageerrors after climbing back mid-run — main's linkdrive died three ways exactly there; this branch's walkaway-and-return is clean.

Two long-standing feel gates were reading puppeteer round-trip latency, not the sim tick — re-anchored to park at a clean baseline and capture the whole barrel spring inside one sync evaluate. Red on main, green by construction now.
